question.text:
For which of the following parameters the structural isomers $\mathrm{C}_2 \mathrm{H}_5 \mathrm{OH}$ and $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{OCH}_3$ would be expected to have the same values?
(Assume ideal behaviour)

options.text: Gaseous densities at the same temperature and pressure
Vapour pressure at the same temperature

solution.text: $\because$ the molecular weight of $\mathrm{C}_2 \mathrm{H}_5 \mathrm{OH} \& \mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{OCH}_3$ are same so in its vapour phase at same temperature \& pressure the densities will be same
